name: Magic Shop Simulator
summary:
Magic shop simulator: is a first-person, open-world sandbox simulation game where players manage and expand a magical store. The core gameplay revolves around foraging for ingredients, brewing potions, and selling goods to customers. Players can automate their shops daily operations by hiring workers to help handle foraging, brewing potions, and serving customers.

A central mechanic of the game is a risk- and-reward system involving four ward stones that protect the shop from monsters. Players must try to balance the cost between keeping the stones charged, allowing threats into the plaza, so they can gather the materials for their shop, and risking their shops risk reputation.
